part: A, the frozen laboratory on several Linux distributions
status_when_written: NOT RUN. Written before the laboratory was run in any of these images.
rule_for_python: Python 3.10 or newer is either already in the image or installed from the distribution's own package repository in a derived image built from the two-line Dockerfile named in the entry. No other source of Python. A distribution that offers no Python 3.10 or newer in its own repositories is recorded as NOT_APPLICABLE with the version found; it is not replaced by another image.
not_included: python:3.15-slim is published (the tag 3 points to 3.15) but is not in the list of the prompt and is not run.
run_conditions: Each image is run once, in a container with --network none, with the unpacked supplement mounted read-only at /supp and one output folder at /out. Derived images are built beforehand with network access to the distribution's own package mirrors only.
expected_for_every_image: in Supplement/sesstrace: <python> -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v exits 0 and runs 36 tests

in Supplement/sesstrace: <python> -B run_benchmark.py --out-dir <temp> exits 0, and each of the 12 files in <temp>/traces/ is byte-identical to the file of the same name in Supplement/sesstrace/results/traces/
in Supplement: <python> -B sesstrace/expiry_witness.py --out-dir <temp2> exits 0, and <temp2>/expiry_results.json, read as JSON, equals Supplement/reference/expiration/expiry_results.json

result_words.IDENTICAL: all three commands exit 0, 36 tests run, 12 of 12 trace files byte-identical, the expiration result equal
result_words.DIFFERENT: the three commands ran in the image but at least one expected item differs; the difference is stated exactly
result_words.FAILED: the image could not be built or started, or a command produced no output to compare; the reason is stated
result_words.NOT_APPLICABLE: no Python 3.10 or newer is offered by the distribution's own repositories; the version found is stated

recorded_per_image: how many of the 12 trace files are identical
whether the expiration result is equal
